evidence.quote: Context: After an order is paid, the application calls the outlet's tablet synchronously

feedback.summary: Excellent work — you scored 39/40. Keep your current habits — showing working, naming concrete techniques, and acknowledging downsides — as they are exactly what the top rubric levels reward.
